Hardt is the most interesting person here at duke. his ideas are original and thoghut provoking, his down-to-earth socialist perspectives makes class a learning experience not a regime. Readings are relevant to everything in life, you will come out with a different, more polished view on so much.

You can't bring prepared answers to the exam anymore, but you can bring two pages of notes. A lot of the time there was too much reading for me to finish before class, but the lectures were great so I was able to understand everything anyways.

A decade later, Hardt still remembers my name, agreed to meet me for coffee with the same enthusiasm and willingness to share thoughts as before.  What I learned in class has shaped my attitudes toward taking ownership of my labor and broadened my definition of love and understanding of existing social structures . For those who think deeply.

Such an amazing and intelligent professor. You need to take one of her classes; it will truly change your life. Captivating lectures and very important content. This class inspired me to minor in sociology.

Valentino's class was one of the best ones I've taken at Duke. Lectures were insightful & I looked forward to coming to class to hear her clearly explain a new facet of social inequality. this prof has transitioned to online classes awesomely, her recorded lectures are so good and you can tell she really cares about her students, didn't know what to expect from this class, but it really made me think about things differently

Awful at lecturing, usually loses his thoughts and barely does any examples in class. Had to self-study the course with my peers, since he assigns so much homework (some stuff he didn't even cover). Grading was very unclear and inconsistent; pretty much depends on whether he likes you or not. With all due respect, he is too old and should retire.

The worst teacher I have ever had. Lectures are extremely incoherent, with the professor never once doing a single practice problem the entire semester. Concepts are impossible to understand without outside help. He is very old and has lapses in speech and forgets what he was talking about. Lessons are unstructured and he repeats them.

He really cares that his students understand the material, but the way he goes about ensuring this is one of the most painful lecture styles I have ever attended. Coolest Professor at Duke, hands down. Helps you in job search and acts like a dad sometimes. Nobody cares about your future as much as this guy if you go to him. He expects good quality work, but its not that hard at all. Great stories.

BV is one of the nicest people I have met and easily the best teacher I have ever had. The workload is very reasonable, and as long as you put in the effort it is not hard to get an A. Shira was a great professor for calc 1. She really cares for students and gives an incredible amount of resources in preparation for tests. review_highlights.comment: Moo is the man. This class is by far the best seminar for kids that need some help boosting thier freshmen gpa. The guy is a genius, but he is also a real person that does not expect too much from his students. The kids look forward to going to his class, which is pretty much mandatory. If you want to skip, this might not be the class for you.

Easy class. He gave our entire class an A in the end so none of the work even mattered. You are only expected to write a few short papers and one project. During class you just talk about random cool stuff since he knows everything. The man is a genius and hilarious and highly recommended to anyone who wants an easy A science requirement.

What can I say about the Great Han? Well, we have a facebook fan club because he is just THAT awesome. The class is awesome, little to no work, easy grades. It was the one class I looked forward to. He is HILARIOUS but if you look up his credentials, you realize he is damn smart. Take this class.

Wacky.  A bit hard to understand because of his fairly heavy accent, but made the class very interesting.  Had him for Modern Physics in my senior year, so I wasn't that motivated.  But overall I would recommend the professor.  He studied under Heisenberg, if I recall correctly.  Very cool stories!

Great class.  If you are truly interested in subatomic physics you will learn a lot from one of the pioneers of the subject (as long as you ask questions).  Also great if you just want an easy grade for your seminar class.  Either way, Prof Han is a great guy and you'll enjoy going to class.

Unclear grading and we needed to trauma dump to get a good grade. Students participated several times a day and didn't get full points. She encouraged us to use symbolic writing, but marked off points for using symbolism and not getting to the point. Tried to appease her standards, but she changed her expectations for every paper.

I am very frustrated because this was my favorite class at Duke but think the grading is absurd. Professor Zagbayou has an unrealistic standard of her students and even though I wholeheartedly believe I put my absolute best forward, I received an A-. It is sad because I cannot recommend her to others because of the GPA, yet it is such a good class.

Not a bad person, but not a good professor. Holds her students to a higher standard than she holds herself. I would take this class over and over again. Decent amount of readings, but they are chosen carefully. Professor Zagbayou cares about her students, taking their feedback, and picking the best guest lectures. Everything applies to the real world. Grading is tough, ignore previous 5 but difficulty 3-4 to get an A.

review_highlights.comment: Dr. Rosenthal is a really great professor. I enjoyed having him (even at 8:30am). His Abnormal Psychology class is really engaging. This class is NOT as easy as people make it out to be.  I took this class expecting an easy A and scraped by with a B+. Work load isn't heavy, but it is an 8:30 AM class and 25% of the final material comes from what was lectured in class.  Averaged a B- on midterm/final, with heavy study. Tests are not curved, essay around 20 pages.

Really awesome professor. Cool guy and he makes the lectures interesting. He tells stories about the fascinating things he's seen in his own clinical experience. Tests really not too hard if you take notes in class, and you don't need the textbook at all.

He is an awesome teacher and so fair in grading it's ridiculous.  Yes, you have to review the lectures slides for a few minutes for a pop quiz, but they're very easy.  The test is extremely fair too.  I started studying the night before and got an A easily.  As an engineer, a professor like Dr. R is a breath of fresh air.  Hilarious & genuine guy!

Dr. Rosenthal is a great lecturer. He keeps class interesting. The exams are doable if you read the textbook and take notes in class. He is very knit-picky about language, but he makes sure to clarify his points if people are confused. Dr. Rosenthal also does his best to make sure the whole class is invested and paying attention to his lecture.
